beats.care: Travelling to Vizag, Kakinada or Odisha this week, or have family there? Check alerts and plan around Oct 27–28.
beats.what: IMD says the system could become a depression today, a deep depression Sunday, and a cyclonic storm by Monday morning.
beats.why: Landfall may be between Gopalpur in Odisha and Kakinada in Andhra Pradesh. Some models show winds up to 145 km/h and a 1–2 metre storm surge.

cards.body: Odisha cancelled officials' leave and put NDRF and ODRAF teams on standby. Red alerts are out for Puri, Ganjam and Gajapati on Oct 27, and several north Andhra districts on Oct 27–28.
After the monsoon, the Bay of Bengal stays warm and winds are favourable, so October to December is its busiest cyclone season.
cards.title: why so many cyclones in October?

cards.q: Do you have family on the Odisha or Andhra coast?
Between which two places might the storm cross the coast?
cards.why: Odisha's minister said models point to landfall between Gopalpur (Odisha) and Kakinada (A.P.).

cover.label: possible winds if the cyclone turns very severe

hook: A *cyclone* may hit the Odisha–Andhra coast by Monday

learn.t: A storm surge is sea water pushed onto land by a cyclone's winds. It often causes more damage than the wind itself.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Odisha, A.P. brace for storm as low pressure intensifies (print, Hyderabad edition, 24 Oct, p.12)

tldr: A low-pressure area in the Bay of Bengal could become a severe cyclone and cross the south Odisha–north Andhra coast by October 28.

steps.e: May cross the coast between Gopalpur and Kakinada

watch: IMD will name the storm and fix the landfall point over the weekend. Watch for evacuation orders on Oct 26–27.
